summary: The Nifty has slipped just below Thursday's close while mid- and smallcaps lag and decliners outnumber advancers, so the morning's relief has turned into a slow, narrow drift lower.

detail.leaders: Realty; Transport Corporation of India; select autos
detail.tone: Slightly weaker than 12:30: the Nifty has turned negative at 23,036.65 (−0.11%) and breadth is negative at 1,826 advancers vs 2,256 decliners on BSE. VIX is still subdued, so the selling is thin rather than forced.
watch: Whether the Nifty holds 23,000 into the last two hours
